{"action": "run_sql", "sql": "
WITH RECURSIVE 
-- First, get all completed orders in CA in 2024
completed_orders AS (
    SELECT o.order_id, o.store_id, o.order_date
    FROM orders o
    JOIN store s ON o.store_id = s.store_id
    WHERE s.country = 'CA'
      AND o.status = 'completed'
      AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01'
      AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01'
),

-- Get order lines with their SKUs
order_lines_with_sku AS (
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.qty as line_qty,
        l.sku_id,
        sk.is_bundle
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
    JOIN sales_sku sk ON l.sku_id = sk.sku_id
    WHERE ol.order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM completed_orders)
),

-- For non-bundle SKUs, get models directly
non_bundle_models AS (
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.line_qty * sm.qty as units,
        sm.model_id
    FROM order_lines_with_sku ol
    JOIN sku_model sm ON ol.sku_id = sm.sku_id
    WHERE ol.is_bundle = false
),

-- For bundle SKUs, explode to item SKUs then to models
bundle_items AS (
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.line_qty * bi.qty as item_qty,
        bi.item_sku_id
    FROM order_lines_with_sku ol
    JOIN bundle_item bi ON ol.sku_id = bi.bundle_sku_id
    WHERE ol.is_bundle = true
),

bundle_models AS (
    SELECT 
        bi.order_id,
        bi.item_qty * sm.qty as units,
        sm.model_id
    FROM bundle_items bi
    JOIN sku_model sm ON bi.item_sku_id = sm.sku_id
),

-- Combine all model units
all_model_units AS (
    SELECT * FROM non_bundle_models
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM bundle_models
)

-- Get top 3 models by total units
SELECT 
    cm.model_code,
    SUM(amu.units) as total_units
FROM all_model_units amu
JOIN company_model cm ON amu.model_id = cm.model_id
GROUP BY cm.model_code
ORDER BY total_units DESC
LIMIT 3
"}
